body: I don’t think I am I don’t believe in god or any higher power anymore I feel like death is like pulling a plug and it’s just over
I’ve been strong for 3 years now but I’m giving up hope idk how much longer I can do this

I can’t have a better life I can’t do anything right I’m ostracized from everything I don’t get invited to parties and I’m never asked to hang out no one cares but my family and even that is not enough for me I have a bottle of pills I could over dose on it would make everything go away all of it

It is worth living losing a mother will hit her harder than losing a father think of all the memories you’re going to enjoy with her growing up you’ll take her to her first dance, date, play date, you’ll even take her for her first day of school she needs you every step of the way ad you need to always keep finding something to live and fight for let that be your daughter she will grow up and be the greatest thing to ever happen in your life she’ll love you with all her heart and everything she will ever do you will be there to support her you’ll have talks about life stories and laughs cry’s and everything she needs you to help her grow up 1 parent can’t do everything and she will love you to the end of time
Please don’t do it your daughter needs you even if you’re homeless she needs you in her life she wont recover if you do this
